items.title: Robinhood's second fund for retail investors eyeing private markets starts trading
items.summary: Robinhood's second venture fund debuted on Thursday, giving retail investors access to early-stage startups that have traditionally been ‌out of reach for all but venture capital firms and wealthy ‌investors.  The fintech company's Robinhood Ventures Fund II raised $225.5 million, which will be invested in early- and growth-stage ​private companies.  RVII opened on the NYSE at $22.50 after pricing the initial public offering of 8 million shares at $25 apiece.
